item.title: As mainland China tightens its tax rules, can Hong Kong remain a magnet for billionaires?
item.description: For decades, Hong Kong has been a magnet for the rich. From wealthy Chinese setting up family trusts to millionaires migrating from across Southeast Asia, all of them have been sucked in by the city’s promise of free capital flows, a trustworthy legal system and extensive financial expertise. item.title: China is using AI facial ID to track migrating fish in Tibet’s largest river
